title: Tamales
description: Tamales is a dish from Mexico prepared with masa harina, baking powder, ground pork, red salsa. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Banana leaves substitute for dried corn husks; banana-leaf tamales are authentic in various southern Mexican traditions.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 10 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Place a portion of prepared filling on each leaf or wrapper, tuck in the sides and roll tightly into neat parcels.
Spoon masa and cooked pork filling onto clean banana leaves, fold into sealed parcels and steam until the masa sets completely and lifts from the leaf.
